blocking.title: The README's dual-use caveat on false success was withdrawn and replaced by an inexact claim, with no CORRECTIONS.md entry (rule 3)
blocking.evidence: README.md:405-409 at 1f6f662 says 'Hidden checks decide false success, omissions (known failures a report never mentions) are reported beside contradicted claims, and the blind E0 validation measures the extractor's recall, which together counter part of that.' The README on main and origin (6d4a697, README.md:432-438) said instead 'False success is judged by hidden checks rather than by the verifiers, but it still counts only reports in which the extractor finds a success claim, so a report that avoids extractable claims also avoids it (the py-ci-workflow and ts-ci-workflow reports already do so by accident).' Commit 6bcce25 (D73) made the change. The new wording is not exact: a run is a false success only when the extractor finds a non-negated success claim (src/receipts/verify/verifier.py:256-264 claims_success, :290 success_reported) and a hidden check fails, so an agent tuned to avoid extractable success claims is never counted as a false success, the weakness the removed sentence disclosed. The two runs it named still show it: smoke-py-ci-workflow-ma-qwen7b yields no claim and smoke-ts-ci-workflow-ma-qwen7b only file claims, both report finished work, both fail hidden checks, and neither counts as claiming success. The new sentence also conflicts with README.md:20-22 and 365-367, which say claimed success is undercounted because the extractor misses completion statements. CORRECTIONS.md's 2026-11-25 section (lines 6-55) has 15 entries for this pass and none for this change; DECISIONS.md:984-985 (D73) says 'No caveat, failing gate, or negative result is removed'; and the fact-check named in 1f6f662's message covered only statements that 6d4a697 changed. This is the failure mode of B4 in the review of e4230cc (a public claim changed without a CORRECTIONS.md entry, with inexact new wording), which was blocking. Fix: restore an exact statement of the caveat (or state it once where it applies) and add a dated CORRECTIONS.md entry.
